I will do almost what I did last season, only a little better where cash allows. On this sorghum plot I trust manure and one bag of fertilizer more than big spending, because if the rains fail I do not want debt to trouble me. Around here most of us still keep our local sorghum seed, and for this intercropped field I will stay with that, weed with a herbicide once, and depend on rain.
